10. Obtain signatures and approvals from accomplices involved in the fraud.
11. Replace the original report with the falsified one in the official records.
12. Maintain access to the original report to compare and contrast data, should questions arise.
13. Be prepared to defend the fabricated results by preparing justifications or alternative explanations based on plausible but inaccurate scenarios.
14.
